caption: The drawing depicts a wooden four-poster bed with a canopy. The bedposts are made of brown wood and feature intricately turned designs. The bed is covered with a light-colored, possibly white or pale cream bedspread decorated with a pattern of small blue or violet flower-like designs. Over the bed is a draped, semi-transparent canopy made from netted or lacy fabric, which is primarily white but shows hints of blue and lavender due to shading. The canopy is attached to the tops of the posts and arches above the bed, hanging down in scalloped edges. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. The composition centers the bed, showing it from an angled perspective that allows a clear view of both its ornate headboard and side.
title: Bed
